Continue study · Method → new work

Continue the Method, Not the Motif

A house continues most convincingly when successors inherit ways of asking, testing, making, and refusing—not a requirement to reproduce familiar motifs.

Read the exhibition

00

The proposition

Succession discourse often asks whether a new collection “looks like” the founder. That test rewards quotation and surface recognition. Archives can support a deeper reading: patterns, rejected samples, fitting notes, research trails, correspondence, oral histories, and material experiments may reveal how decisions were made. The V&A’s designer collections and Ferré Research Center make methods researchable while their media remain governed by item-level rights.

Method is not neutral or singular. Founders contradict themselves, collaborators shape practice, commercial pressures alter decisions, and archives preserve some voices better than others. A successor must therefore encounter multiple records and dissent, distinguish durable values from period habits, and document how a new answer relates to an old question. Continuity becomes an accountable transformation rather than resemblance theater.

01–04

The institutional sequence

01 · QUESTION

Which problems animated the work?

Identify recurring questions about body, material, power, movement, labor, audience, technology, or refusal from dated records—not retrospective slogans.

INFERENCES11S21S67

02 · METHOD

How were answers tested?

Recover research, cut, drape, fitting, casting, collaboration, critique, rejection, and revision practices, including exceptions and contributor accounts.

INFERENCES72S73S74S75

03 · TRANSLATE

What changes in the new context?

Name new bodies, materials, technologies, laws, workers, audiences, and cultural authorities; explain what the inherited method cannot answer unchanged.

PROPOSALS38S76S88

04 · CITE

Can evolution show its lineage?

Attach source, interpretation, transformation, contributor, permission, dissent, and successor rationale so continuity is neither copy nor amnesia.

PROPOSALS08S39

COUNTERPOINT

What this framework could get wrong

“Continue the method” can itself become founder worship or selective history. Methods may encode exclusion, unsafe labor, or outdated assumptions. Successors need permission to reject as well as inherit.

FIELDWORK

Do the work now

Use this as a working session, not a score.

  1. Choose one historic question supported by three records.
  2. Recover two methods and one contradiction.
  3. Translate the question for a changed body, material, or social context.
  4. Invite contributors and specialists to challenge the lineage claim.

Reading protocol

Every material statement carries an evidence label and point-of-claim source links. Interpretation is never presented as source fact. Legal sections identify their jurisdiction; state, foreign, contractual, beneficial-ownership, validity, priority, and disputed-fact questions remain counsel-review gates. This exhibition is educational and does not provide legal, conservation, or business advice.
